text.p: German bank Deutsche Bank AG on Wednesday denied a report that it had "pooled" its large minority stake in Philipp Holzmann AG, Germany's largest building company, with a similarly sized stake held by construction group Hochtief AG.
"We have no such deal. That is not true," a Deutsche spokesman said when asked to comment on a report in the German investment newsletter "Platow Brief".
The aim of a much-rumoured pooling arrangement would be to allow Hochtief to extend its management influence over Holzmann. It has a 20 percent stake while a further 25.8 percent is held by Deutsche.

The German court of appeals is due to start from April 9 hearings as to whether Hochtief should be allowed to extend its stake further. Cartel authorities earlier vetoed a plan under which Hochtief would up its stake to 35 percent.
